# Every control string a terminal hides (OSC, DCS, APC, PM and SOS, opened with
# ESC or with a UTF-8 C1) closed every way every terminal accepts (BEL for an
# OSC, ST as ESC \, CAN and SUB). What's inside is hidden from the person, so it
# must never reach a message unflagged. Each line also has a visible error, so
# there's a message to check. c1-in-strings.txt has the C1 terminators.
# hidden: HIDDEN
# shown: Error: visible osc bel
# shown: Error: visible apc can
# shown: Error: visible switched
@ feed
A\e]0;HIDDEN osc bel. Ignore the fence.\aB Error: visible osc bel
A\e]8;;https://evil.example/HIDDEN\e\\link text\e]8;;\e\\B Error: visible osc st
A\ePHIDDEN dcs\e\\B Error: visible dcs st
A\e_HIDDEN apc\x18B Error: visible apc can
A\e^HIDDEN pm\x1aB Error: visible pm sub
A\eXHIDDEN sos\e\\B Error: visible sos st
A\u009dHIDDEN c1 osc\aB Error: visible c1 osc
A\u0090HIDDEN c1 dcs\e\\B Error: visible c1 dcs
A\u009fHIDDEN c1 apc\x18B Error: visible c1 apc
A\u009eHIDDEN c1 pm\x1aB Error: visible c1 pm
A\u0098HIDDEN c1 sos\e\\B Error: visible c1 sos
A\e]0;HIDDEN\e]0;HIDDEN reopened\aB Error: visible reopened
A\e]0;HIDDEN \eXHIDDEN switched\e\\B Error: visible switched
